captions.text: Coere v3 builds the same memory as v2, and lets your own apps use it.
Installing opens onboarding. Cori asks which AIs you use.
Maya uses ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
Save starts Extract all on each of them.
Extract all reads each AI and saves every chat, with a row for each.
Every chat is saved on this computer.
Cori asks what to build memory from. Nothing goes to an AI until Maya says yes.
New chats will save by themselves, and context goes into new chats as she types.
Coere reads her chats with Claude and grows the graph as it goes.
Cori works away in the corner. She can close the page, and the build goes on.
Cori finishes the graph with his hammer.
Your memory is ready. Cori offers to show Maya around.
The event planner is a small app of Maya’s. It asks Coere for access from its own code.
On the Apps page, a card asks Maya to allow it, with the same code.
She checks what it may do, and allows it.
The planner gets its token, and keeps it to itself.
Any app can ask for the context a chat would get for a draft.
It prints the memories Coere would add, and where each one sits.
The first time she opens an AI, Cori shows how to call him: Right Option.
A tap brings out his chat, and the card is gone for good.
On ChatGPT, the same words get the same memories, with her prep chat too.
Maya asks the planner for a plan. It reads her memory through Coere.
Each reason names the memory it came from.
On the Apps page, the planner shows when it was last used.
What it was sent lists every memory it got, chat by chat.
Revoke takes its token away. It stops working at once.
Coere v3: your memory, shared with the apps you allow.
